name: Cottage Cheese with Peaches, Blueberries & Maple Syrup
instructions: Wash, dry, and quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Medium dice the flesh.
To serve, divide cottage cheese, peaches, and blueberries between bowls. Drizzle with maple syrup and enjoy!
author: Mealime
